CustomObject.description: A named Super Transform step list: which object, which records and what to change, saved as one documented JSON document (canonical model Section 29P, C-50f1). Org-wide: everyone who may use Super Transform sees, loads, renames and deletes every list. Holds no records and grants access to none; loading a list fills the page in, and the run still checks everything as the person.
CustomObject.label: Saved Transform
